response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as award_count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), total_awards AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) as total_count FROM award_counts) SELECT ac.player_id, ac.award_count, CAST(ac.award_count AS FLOAT) / ta.total_count as fraction FROM award_counts ac CROSS JOIN total_awards ta WHERE ta.total_count IS NOT NULL AND ta.total_count > 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
